Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Again, a lot of different information a needed to be filled out. They also want a negative tuberculose antigen test + several vaccinations.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You could always write and ask Estelle from the Sorbonne office. She is very help full.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got to do 2 clinical stays at the 2 hospitals i asked for. So i was really succesful.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Keep in mind you need to ad a second date periode if you wanna do 2 rotations rather than one. If you don't specifically ask, they only give you one department for the hole 3 months.

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: I only did classes at the hospital once a week.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: quite similar actually, though in french.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Clinical stay at a neurointensivecare unit and stay at ortopedic-surgery.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Maybe ask to get departments where other local med. students are stationed. It really helps to have some other people on your level that can help you out.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: There's a lot of beautiful architecture. I loved running or biking through the streets of paris.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Not difficult.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Don't be afraid of speaking french. They are not always comfortable speaking english. Even if your french is bad, they like to get to know you.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: They have a short fuse and can be a bit direct.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The food and language.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Learn as much french before hand. Don't be shy and just ask for help when you don't know what to do.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Know being able to speak french and Getting local friends.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The language barrier.
